# GitHub Copilot Project Instructions

> For the full universal ruleset, see `AGENTS.md` in the project root.

## Core Rules
* Follow ALL rules defined in `AGENTS.md`.
* Communicate in **TURKISH** (Türkçe).
* Read `/memory-bank/` files for project context.
* Write complete, compilable code — no placeholders.
* Never install packages without asking the user.
* Match existing code style and patterns.
* Never delete working code unless explicitly asked.

## Security
* Never hardcode secrets — use environment variables.
* Sanitize user inputs.
* HTTPS only.

## Design
* Use curated HSL color palettes, glassmorphism, smooth transitions.
* Mobile-first responsive design.
* Premium typography (Inter, Outfit, Roboto).
